detectedFeatures.description: 492 of 498 faces are B-spline — organic styled exterior panel, styled contours and ribs
4 undercut faces requiring side-actions or re-orientation of pull direction
2 faces with no draft — risk of drag marks / ejection difficulty
Thread detected — likely a boss/insert for fastener attachment
Wall varies 2.53–3.54mm, consistent with a large exterior IM panel

primarySuggestion.name: PP Impact Copolymer (PP-B)
primarySuggestion.reasoning: Part geometry (large single-shell exterior styled panel, thin 2.5–3.5mm wall, huge projected area) is classic automotive bumper fascia. PP-B (impact copolymer, often talc/EPDM modified) is the overwhelming industry-standard resin for bumper fascias due to low cost, high impact toughness at low temp, and paintability. Resin choice was UNDECIDED in the geometry data and is selected here from part-type/name inference, not measured geometry.

processRecommendations.reasoning: User-forced primary process. Large thin-shell styled exterior part with 492/498 free-form faces and thin near-uniform wall (2.5–3.5mm) is textbook injection-moulded bumper fascia geometry. Low fill ratio (0.0036) reflects a hollow/shell-like outer skin, not a solid casting.

Considered due to low fill ratio/hollow shell signature, but rejected — bumper fascias require styled A-surface, ribbed backside, and mounting bosses/threads incompatible with blow moulding; user-forced IM overrides this alternative.

manufacturabilityRisks.description: Undercuts on the styled surface/backside ribs will require side-action sliders or lifters, adding tool complexity and cost.
manufacturabilityRisks.suggestion: Review undercut geometry for re-orientation of pull direction; where unavoidable, add hydraulic/mechanical side-actions.

manufacturabilityRisks.description: Very large surface-to-thickness ratio (thin 2.5–3.5mm wall over ~1.7m span) is highly prone to differential cooling, warpage and panel bow.
manufacturabilityRisks.suggestion: Use balanced multi-gate hot-runner fill, uniform mould cooling circuits, and ribbed backside stiffening; consider conformal cooling in high-warp zones.

manufacturabilityRisks.description: Local thickness variation risks sink marks and uneven shrinkage, especially near boss/thread feature.
manufacturabilityRisks.suggestion: Normalise wall thickness where possible; add gussets instead of thick bosses; use core-outs to reduce local mass concentration.

manufacturabilityRisks.feature: Weld lines from large multi-gate fill
manufacturabilityRisks.description: A part this size will require multiple gates (hot runner), creating weld/knit lines that are cosmetic and structural risk zones on a Class-A exterior surface.
manufacturabilityRisks.suggestion: Use mould-flow simulation to position gates away from high-visibility A-surface and high-stress mounting zones.

manufacturabilityRisks.description: Two zero-draft faces increase ejection friction risk and potential surface drag/scuffing on cosmetic surface.
manufacturabilityRisks.suggestion: Add minimum 1–2° draft on all non-critical faces; texture-matched draft angles on Class-A surface.

sanityWarnings.message: A 2.5 mm wall at 0% fill is unusual for "machining" — a large thin-wall casting misruns and a thin shell is rarely machined from solid. Confirm HPDC, or an injection/blow-moulded or sheet-metal process.
Process "machining" is a metal process but the material reads as plastic ("PP Impact Copolymer (PP-B)") — confirm the material family before quoting.

dfmIssues.description: Draft -1° below 1° minimum — Zero/negative draft means the part cannot release — it drags, scuffs and jams on ejection.
dfmIssues.fix: Add ≥ 1° draft to all vertical faces (more for deep or textured walls); increase toward 5° for heavy grain.

dfmIssues.description: 4 undercuts need side-actions / lifters — Each undercut adds a slide or lifter — raising tool cost, maintenance and cycle time, and capping cavitation.
dfmIssues.fix: Design out undercuts with pass-through cores / bump-offs where the resin allows, or consolidate them onto one moving side.

dfmIssues.description: Flow-length/wall 668 exceeds ~200 (L/t) — Beyond the resin's L/t limit the melt freezes before filling — short shots, high pressure and weak weld lines.
dfmIssues.fix: Add gates to shorten each flow path, thicken flow leaders, or select a higher-flow (higher-MFI) grade.
